ValidationRule.description: Contact Records must have first, last, email, and be assigned to account. Created to keep the database clean in the event of potential workarounds or API integrations.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), (OR( ISBLANK(FirstName), ISBLANK( LastName ), ISBLANK( Email ), ISBLANK( AccountId )))) && Contact_Automation_Bypassed__c = False
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact Record must have First Name, Last Name, Email, and be assigned to an Account.
